description: This Java source file defines a REST API route for '/search/things' and related sub-paths, including '/count'. It uses Akka HTTP for route definitions and handles search queries for 'things' with various parameters like filter, options, fields, and namespaces. The class 'ThingSearchRoute' extends 'AbstractRoute' and provides methods to build and handle search-related HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: ThingSearchRoute
classes.description: A route builder class for handling HTTP requests related to '/search/things' paths, including count and search operations, with support for various query parameters and delegating commands to an actor system.

methods.name: buildSearchRoute
methods.description: Constructs the Akka HTTP route for '/search/things' and its sub-paths, delegating to specific handlers for 'count' and general search.

methods.name: countThings
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/search/things/count', processing optional filter and namespace query parameters, and triggers a CountThings command.

methods.name: searchThings
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/search/things', processing optional filter, options, fields, namespaces, and pagination parameters, and triggers a QueryThings command.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptional
methods.description: Initializes processing of optional search parameters by iterating over possible parameters and collecting their values.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptionalImpl
methods.description: Recursive helper to collect optional parameter values and once all are processed, execute the provided Route logic.

methods.name: calculateFilter
methods.description: Extracts filter string from Optional and returns null if not present.

methods.name: calculateNamespaces
methods.description: Parses namespaces string into a Set of strings, or null if not provided.

methods.name: calculateOptions
methods.description: Splits options string into a list of options, or null when absent.
